Membership categories

Different pathways. A shared purpose.

SLIID membership is open to practising designers, emerging designers, students and industry partners.

Final eligibility, required documents, fees and review periods will be published after approval by the Executive Council.

Ask about eligibility →

Professional Member

For practising interior designers with recognised qualifications and experience.

Associate Member

For emerging designers and professionals on the path to full membership.

Student Member

For students enrolled in a recognised interior design programme.

Industry Partner

For organisations that support and collaborate with the interior design industry, subject to Council confirmation.

Member benefits

More than a membership. A platform for growth.

Professional recognition

Recognition as a member of the national professional body.

Networking

Meet designers, suppliers and allied professionals.

Industry events

Access workshops and CPD programmes.

Knowledge sharing

Guidance on professional practice and industry issues.

Advocacy

A voice for the profession with government and industry.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Who can apply for SLIID membership?

Practising interior designers, emerging designers, students and eligible industry partners can apply. Category requirements are being confirmed.

What documents are required?

The Executive Council is confirming the documents required for each category. Please do not submit sensitive documents until the secure application service is connected.

How long does the application process take?

Applications are reviewed by the Executive Council. The standard review period will be published once approved.

What are the annual membership fees?

The approved fee schedule will be published here when confirmed.
